allowed_claims: The pinned workflow computed all eight requested vis, amp, cphase, and logcamp diagnostics for the two bands and two observed FITS execution families.
The exact observed reduced-chi-squared values and cross-run deltas may be reported as measurements.
blocked_claims: The reconstructed image satisfies an independently reviewed absolute scientific fit threshold.
The diagnostic refutes calibration-artifact, imaging-prior, jet-only, variability-bias, or non-Kerr alternatives.
The diagnostic authorizes promotion of the M87 reconstruction claim above S3.

limitations: The reports inherit observable definitions, uncertainty handling, data selection, and transform behavior from ehtim 1.1.0.
No observable-specific scientific acceptance thresholds or reviewed degrees-of-freedom assumptions are registered.
The reports compare final FITS images and do not replay every intermediate self-calibration state.
